# Ash Spark

A cantrip: "Evocation Cantrip", the school before the word, and the
Cantrip Upgrade after the text. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: 5e_2024
  card-type: spell
data:
  name: Ash Spark
  level: 0
  school: evocation
  classes: [Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard]
  casting-time: Action
  range: 30 feet
  components: V, S
  duration: Instantaneous
  description: A mote of burning ash leaps at one creature or object you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. *Hit:* 1d8 Fire damage.
  cantrip-upgrade: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
```
